title: Data Types
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: Every DSA bug that “looks algorithmic” is often a type-width mistake. Learn ranges, signedness, and when to promote to 64-bit before you chase weird WA.
intuition: Pick the smallest type that cannot overflow the constraints. When in doubt on sums/products, use 64-bit.
approach: List constraint ranges from the problem.
Choose types that fit peaks (sums, products).
Print with the same type you computed.

python.code:
x = 10**9
y = x * x  # Python ints are arbitrary precision
print(y)
